title: Mixing for Free Semigroup Actions of Blaschke Products on the Circle
summary: We study mixing at a double exponential rate on analytic observables and ask how much of a map is remembered by its rate of mixing. For finite Blaschke products of the circle with a fixed point in the unit disk, and for the free semigroup actions they generate, we give a complete classification: the rate of mixing (no mixing, exponential, or double exponential) is determined by the multiplier of the generators at that fixed point, the invariant measure being the harmonic measure with a pole there.
